title: QNu Labs and India's NIELIT Sign MoU to Establish Hub-and-Spoke Quantum Labs and Workforce Training - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Indian quantum cybersecurity provider QNu Labs has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT), an autonomous scientific society under India’s Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), to expand quantum technology education and workforce training. Under the agreement, the organizations will develop specialized curricula and certification programs in quantum technologies and quantum-safe cybersecurity while establishing Quantum Labs across participating institutions via a Hub-and-Spoke model.

To connect institutional instruction with commercial deployment, the collaboration includes hands-on training through laboratory demonstrations, projects, and hackathons, alongside Faculty Development and Train-the-Trainer programs, internships, and on-the-job industry placements.
